Engaging with Microsoft's most strategic customers and partners on joint development projects to enable organizations to push boundaries, leveraging expertise in cutting-edge technologies such as AI, cloud-native computing, data, and intelligence at the edge.  As reported by customers, Robert facilitates massive business value realization and fortifies customer competitiveness and differentiated positions in their markets.

positions.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Commercial Software Engineering
positions.description: Working directly with Microsoft's Top 200 customers and partners doing joint development to tackle their hardest business and technical challenges to create production solutions using leading technologies including cloud native application development, AI/ML, and IoT.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Corporate and Investment Bank, Core Pricing Technologies

Leadership:
- Mentoring and growing team members hard and soft skills with sponsorship of senior management and executive leadership 
- Led Dev Team’s product pivot from heritage to greenfield serving $100MM+ clients of the firm.
- Forged strategic partnerships between Architecture, Infra, Ops, and Dev - with Product and Management buy-in - resulting in the delivery of a Kubernetes cluster servicing three environments across two geographic regions for $100MM+ clients of the firm

Technical Ownership:
- Q4'21 - Q2'22: Product metrics dashboards, alerting, montioring etc.  Product Quality: Functional tests, Production Deploys, End to End tests, Performance tests.  Secure Software Development: Zero-day patching and Data-in-transit encryption
- Q1 & Q2: Interim Engineering Domain Owner & acting Chicago-Tampa Dev Lead, Caliber Pricing
- Both RESTFUL and Event-Driven micro-services on Public/Private Hybrid Cloud, from Zero to One

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Corporate and Investment Bank, Core Cash Technologies

- Delivered a $4B+/day suite of cash processing micro-services, from Zero to One, on Kubernetes.
- Close collaboration with JPMorgan’s AI and Data Science teams to deliver next generation real time digital negotiation of real and virtual payments instruments for deposit for the most globally impactful of the firm’s clients.

positions.title: Product Development Engineer
positions.description:
- Cut time spent by >200% per engineer on critical workflow by developing software for EE's via python app development: interactive platform simulation configuration and launch;  batch processing of simulation result data with human-readable report generation.

- 5G Platform Controller Hub (PCH) product for enterprise clients
- Developed and debuged complex software to convert design validation vectors and drive complex test equipment
- Significantly contributed to design, evaluation, development, debug, and validation of complex test methods & circuits
- Responsible for ensuring the testability and manufacturability of integrated circuits from the component feasibility stage through production ramp
- Tested, validated, modified and re-designed circuits to guarantee component margin to specification
- Created and applied concepts for optimizing component production relative to both quality and cost constraints
- Analyzed and evaluated component specification vs performance to ensure optimal match of component requirements with production equipment capability with emphasis on yield analysis and bin split capability

positions.title: UEFI BIOS Firmware Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- UEFI BIOS (firmware) development in Post-DXE environment for new 10nm process (Row Access Strobe) targeting Embedded devices in C/C++
- Sped Firmware product time-to-market by standing up a continuous integration cluster with heterogeneous (*NIX & NT) guest operating systems from bare metal in the server room 
- Python web development mining project metrics piped to web dashboard
- Built my own remote dev box in the server room from bare metal to running Windows + Linux for python software development
positions.insights: Skills: Software Engineering · Software Development · C (Programming Language) · C++

positions.title: 2017 Fellow
positions.description: Code2040 is a mentorship program (9% admissions rate) designed to help individuals plan their careers in tech. To be selected as a fellow one must demonstrate engineering excellence through past projects, academic achievements, and a commitment to increasing diversity in technology.

positions.title: Software QA Intern
positions.description:
- $30k/yr positive bottom line impact by writing C# and Javascript to implement a software feature that streamlined a tax write-off process
- Designed, developed, refactored, debugged and documented automated test suites & unit tests; Root-caused and reproduced software defects 
- Analyzed requirements and specifications within formal design documents to identify testable statements

positions.title: Visiting Research Fellow
positions.description:
Fellowship: School of Engineering and Applied Sciences.

- Whitesides Research Group, Metamaterials
- Successful 3.2x resolution improvement & 2.5x reduction in silicon wafer sample fabrication time

- Led nano-fabrication processes, including electron beam evaporation, photolithography, wet chemical etching and scanning electron microscopy
- Perform approximately 150 hours of independent nano-fabrication within the Laboratory for Integrated Science and Engineering (LISE) nanofabrication facility.
- Independently planned and completed advanced training in world class scanning electron microscopy hardware and techniques to gather data from leading edge experimental silicon samples
- Presented samples live to Harvard Professors at SEAS symposium
- Iterated on silicon samples & experiments via analysis, interpretation, and documentation of experimental results

A National Science Foundation Division of Materials Research and NSF Engineering Directorate Project
https://www.nsf.gov/awardsearch/show-award/?AWD_ID=1262895

positions.title: Senior Avionics Technician
positions.description:
Working with the very first F-35 Squadrons of the Navy and Marine Corps team.

Transistor level debug and repair of Distributed Systems incl. Fiber Optic, Internetworking, and Wireless Communications systems.  Cryptographic keying for secure encrypted communications, handling and deployment of SECRET & SCI cryptographic assets.  Encrypted handling and protection of personally identifiable and protected information.  General Electronic & Electrical Systems w/ emphasis on Wireless for Aerospace.

E-4, MOS: 5954

projects.description:
Professional contractual work for "Hands On Helping," A charity that offers English education to low income students in Cambodia.

Utilizing technology such as jQuery, AJAX, PHP5, Apache2, HTML5, CSS3 on a Linux platform.

organizations.name: IEEE-CS
organizations.description: The IEEE Computer Society is the world's home for computer science, engineering, and technology.  A global leader in providing access to computer science research, analysis, and information, the IEEE Computer Society offers a comprehensive array of unmatched products, services and opportunities for individuals at all stages of their professional career.  Known as the premier organization that empowers the people who drive technology, its unparalleled resources include membership, international conferences, peer-reviewed publications, a unique digital library, standards, and training programs.

organizations.name: Association for Computing Machinery
organizations.description:
ACM brings together computing educators, researchers, and professionals to inspire dialogue, share resources, and address the field's challenges. As the world’s largest computing society, ACM strengthens the profession's collective voice through strong leadership, promotion of the highest standards, and recognition of technical excellence. ACM supports the professional growth of its members by providing opportunities for life‐long learning, career development, and professional networking.

Founded at the dawn of the computer age, ACM’s reach extends to every part of the globe, with more than half of its nearly 100,000 members residing outside the U.S.  Its growing membership has led to Councils in Europe, India, and China, fostering networking opportunities that strengthen ties within and across countries and technical communities.  Their actions enhance ACM’s ability to raise awareness of computing’s important technical, educational, and social issues around the world.
